title: The coord hook backs off after a failed ask poll and prints a new ask once across parallel hook runs
goal: new_asks records asks_at after a coord call that failed or timed out, so a busy store costs the poll at most once per ASK_POLL_SECONDS, and two PreToolUse hooks of one session started together print a new ask once

run:
import json,os,sys,tempfile,subprocess as s
D=tempfile.mkdtemp();bad=os.path.join(D,'store-is-a-dir');os.makedirs(bad)
sid='chk-backoff-'+os.urandom(4).hex();E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=bad)
ev={'hook_event_name':'PreToolUse','session_id':sid,'tool_name':'Read','tool_input':{'file_path':'x'},'cwd':os.getcwd(),'transcript_path':os.path.join(D,'t.jsonl')}
s.run([sys.executable,'.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py'],input=json.dumps(ev),capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=60)
sys.path.insert(0,'.claude/hooks');import coord_hook
st=coord_hook.load(sid);p=coord_hook.path(sid) if hasattr(coord_hook,'path') else None
print('asks_at after a failed poll:',st.get('asks_at'))
for f in os.listdir(coord_hook.STATE):
    if f.startswith('chk-backoff-'): os.remove(os.path.join(coord_hook.STATE,f))
sys.exit(0 if st.get('asks_at') else 1)

notes: SP-w6amecjt review, S4: a failed coord call returns before asks_at is saved; parallel hooks load the same asks_seq.
